# theme
```{r}
figure_theme = theme_bw(base_size = 10, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),

    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.66)
```

# figure a
```{r}
pfd_md = fread(file.path(data_dir, "pfd_metadata.tsv"))
pfd_md_rd = pfd_md %>%
  mutate(source = if_else(grepl("MFD", member_id), "MFD", "DB")) %>%
  select(representative, member_id, db, source, ptu, dptu, length, gc) %>%
  distinct(representative, .keep_all = T) 
# ptu groups
ptu_df = pfd_md_rd %>%
  mutate(ptu = na_if(ptu, "")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ptu)) %>%
  group_by(ptu) %>% 
  mutate(ptu_size = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    ptu_category = case_when(
      all(source == "MFD") ~ "MFD",
      all(source == "DB") ~ "DB",
      TRUE ~ "Shared"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(representative, ptu, source, ptu_category) 

  
db_shared_ptu = ptu_df %>%
  filter(ptu_category %in% c("DB", "Shared"))

mfd_ptu = ptu_df %>%
  filter(ptu_category == "MFD")


ptu_counts = ptu_df %>%
  mutate(
    ptu_category_rf = if_else(
      ptu_category == "MFD",
      "MFD-only",
      "DB-only + Shared"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(ptu_category_rf, ptu, name = "ptu_size")

rf_ptu = as.matrix(xtabs(ptu_size ~ ptu_category_rf + ptu, data = ptu_counts))

rare_ptu = rarecurve(rf_ptu, step = 100, tidy = TRUE) %>%
  rename(
    ptu_category_rf = Site,
    plasmid = Sample,
    ptu = Species
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    plasmid = if_else(
      ptu_category_rf == "MFD-only",
      plasmid + max(plasmid[ptu_category_rf == "DB-only + Shared"]),
      plasmid
    ),
    ptu = if_else(
      ptu_category_rf == "MFD-only",
      ptu + max(ptu[ptu_category_rf == "DB-only + Shared"]),
      ptu
    )
  )

# dptu groups
dptu_df = pfd_md_rd %>%
  mutate(dptu = na_if(dptu, "")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dptu)) %>%
  group_by(dptu) %>% 
  mutate(dptu_size = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    dptu_category = case_when(
      all(source == "MFD") ~ "MFD",
      all(source == "DB") ~ "DB",
      TRUE ~ "Shared"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(representative, dptu, source, dptu_category) 

  
db_shared_dptu = dptu_df %>%
  filter(dptu_category %in% c("DB", "Shared"))

mfd_dptu = dptu_df %>%
  filter(dptu_category == "MFD")


dptu_counts = dptu_df %>%
  mutate(
    dptu_category_rf = if_else(
      dptu_category == "MFD",
      "MFD-only",
      "DB-only + Shared"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(dptu_category_rf, dptu, name = "dptu_size")

rf_dptu = as.matrix(xtabs(dptu_size ~ dptu_category_rf + dptu, data = dptu_counts))

rare_dptu = rarecurve(rf_dptu, step = 100, tidy = TRUE) %>%
  rename(
    dptu_category_rf = Site,
    plasmid = Sample,
    dptu = Species
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    plasmid = if_else(
      dptu_category_rf == "MFD-only",
      plasmid + max(plasmid[dptu_category_rf == "DB-only + Shared"]),
      plasmid
    ),
    dptu = if_else(
      dptu_category_rf == "MFD-only",
      dptu + max(dptu[dptu_category_rf == "DB-only + Shared"]),
      dptu
    )
  )

# combine ptu and dptu rarefaction 
rare_df = bind_rows(
  rare_ptu %>% mutate(group = "PTU"),
  rare_dptu %>%
    rename(ptu_category_rf = dptu_category_rf, ptu = dptu) %>%
    mutate(group = "dPTU")
)

# plot rarefaction
rarefaction = ggplot(rare_df, aes(plasmid, ptu, colour = ptu_category_rf, linetype = group,
                                            group = interaction(group, ptu_category_rf))) +
  geom_line(
    data = bind_rows(
      rare_df,
      rare_df %>%
        filter(ptu_category_rf == "DB-only + Shared") %>%
        group_by(group) %>%
        slice_max(plasmid, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(ptu_category_rf = "MFD-only")
    ),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = rare_df %>%
      group_by(group, ptu_category_rf) %>%
      slice_max(plasmid, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup(),
    size = 1.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("DB-only + Shared" = "gray", "MFD-only" = "blue"),
    breaks = c("DB-only + Shared", "MFD-only")
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("PTU" = "solid", "dPTU" = "11"),
    breaks = c("PTU", "dPTU")
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid")),
    linetype = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    x = "No. of plasmids",
    y = "No. of groups",
    colour = "Categories",
    linetype = "Group"
  ) +
  figure_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.03, 0.97),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.text = element_text(margin = margin(l = 1, unit = "mm")),
    legend.title = element_text(margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm")),
    legend.key.height = unit(4, "mm"),
    legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(1, "mm"),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

rarefaction

```

# figure b
```{r}

pfd_md = fread(file.path(data_dir, "pfd_metadata.tsv"),
               select = c("representative", "member_id", "ptu", "dptu"))
pc = fread(file.path(data_dir, "orfs_mfd_and_reference.tsv"),
           select = c("representative", "member_id", "protein_cluster", "source"))

pc2 = pc %>%
  filter(representative == member_id,
         !is.na(protein_cluster), protein_cluster != "") %>%
  distinct(representative, protein_cluster, source)

# retain source when collapsing plasmids to ptuss/dptus
pc_plasmid = pc2 %>% distinct(representative, protein_cluster, source)
pc_ptu = pc_plasmid %>%
  inner_join(pfd_md %>% distinct(representative, ptu),
             by = "representative", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ptu), ptu != "") %>%
  distinct(ptu, protein_cluster, source)
pc_dptu = pc_plasmid %>%
  inner_join(pfd_md %>% distinct(representative, dptu),
             by = "representative", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(!is.na(dptu), dptu != "") %>%
  distinct(dptu, protein_cluster, source)

step = 5000

# put all three resolutions in the same format
pc_groups = bind_rows(
  pc_plasmid %>% transmute(group = "Plasmid", unit = representative, protein_cluster, source),
  pc_ptu %>% transmute(group = "PTU", unit = ptu, protein_cluster, source),
  pc_dptu %>% transmute(group = "dPTU", unit = dptu, protein_cluster, source)
) %>%
  group_by(group, unit) %>%
  mutate(category = if_else(all(source == "MFD"), "MFD-only", "DB-only + Shared")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(group, unit, protein_cluster, category)

# count all sampling units before removing previously observed pcs
unit_counts = pc_groups %>%
  group_by(group, category) %>%
  summarise(n_units = n_distinct(unit), .groups = "drop")

db_shared = pc_groups %>% filter(category == "DB-only + Shared")

mfd_new = pc_groups %>%
  filter(category == "MFD-only") %>%
  anti_join(db_shared %>% distinct(group, protein_cluster),
            by = c("group", "protein_cluster"))

# count units containing each pc; combine pcs with the same frequency
pc_counts = bind_rows(db_shared, mfd_new) %>%
  count(group, category, protein_cluster, name = "present") %>%
  count(group, category, present, name = "n_pc")

samples = unit_counts %>%
  group_by(group, category) %>%
  reframe(n_units = n_units,
          units = sort(unique(c(0, 1, seq(0, n_units, by = step), n_units))))

samples = samples %>%
  left_join(pc_counts, by = c("group", "category"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(present = coalesce(present, 0L),
         n_pc = coalesce(n_pc, 0L),
         absent = n_units - present)

# vegan::drarefy returns the probability of observing each category.
# we use only the probability of observing "present" units.
# https://vegandevs.github.io/vegan/reference/rarefy.html
pc_matrix = as.matrix(samples %>% select(present, absent))
samples$probability = drarefy(pc_matrix, sample = samples$units)[, "present"]

rare_df = samples %>%
  group_by(group, category, units) %>%
  summarise(protein_clusters = sum(probability * n_pc), .groups = "drop")

# continue blue (mfd-only) from the grey (db-only + shared) endpoint
rare_df = rare_df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(
    units = if_else(category == "MFD-only",
                    units + max(units[category == "DB-only + Shared"]), units),
    protein_clusters = if_else(category == "MFD-only",
                               protein_clusters + max(protein_clusters[category == "DB-only + Shared"]),
                               protein_clusters)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

endpoints = rare_df %>%
  group_by(group, category) %>%
  slice_max(units, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()

pc_rarefaction = ggplot(rare_df,
                        aes(protein_clusters, units, colour = category, linetype = group,
                            group = interaction(group, category))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = endpoints, size = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("DB-only + Shared" = "gray", "MFD-only" = "blue"),
                      breaks = c("DB-only + Shared", "MFD-only")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Plasmid" = "longdash", "PTU" = "solid", "dPTU" = "11"),
                        breaks = c("Plasmid", "PTU", "dPTU")) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Protein clusters (30% identity)", y = "No. of groups",
       colour = "Categories", linetype = "Group") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1)),
         linetype = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1))) +
  figure_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.03, 0.97),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.key.width = unit(10, "mm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(3, "mm"),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  )

```



# figure c
```{r}

pfd = fread(file.path(data_dir, "pfd_metadata.tsv"))
pfd_rd = pfd %>%
  select(representative, ptu, dptu, db, rps, mobs_Name) %>%
  mutate(across(c(representative, ptu, dptu), ~ na_if(trimws(.x), ""))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(representative)) %>%
  distinct(representative, .keep_all = TRUE)

# totals include plasmids without RP or MOB annotations
source_totals = pfd_rd %>%
  mutate(source = if_else(db == "MFD", "MFD", "DB", missing = "DB")) %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(
    plasmids_total = n_distinct(representative),
    ptus_total = n_distinct(ptu, na.rm = TRUE),
    dptus_total = n_distinct(dptu, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# replication proteins
rp_df = pfd_rd %>%
  separate_rows(rps, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(source = if_else(db == "MFD", "MFD", "DB", missing = "DB")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rps), rps != "", rps != "NA") %>%
  group_by(source, rps) %>%
  summarise(
    plasmid_count = n_distinct(representative),
    ptu_count = n_distinct(ptu, na.rm = TRUE),
    dptu_count = n_distinct(dptu, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(rps, source = c("DB", "MFD"),
           fill = list(plasmid_count = 0, ptu_count = 0, dptu_count = 0)) %>%
  left_join(source_totals, by = "source") %>%
  mutate(
    plasmid_pct = plasmid_count / plasmids_total,
    ptu_pct = ptu_count / ptus_total,
    dptu_pct = dptu_count / dptus_total
  )

# mobilisation proteins; exclude MPF annotations from the MOB panel
mob_df = pfd_rd %>%
  separate_rows(mobs_Name, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(source = if_else(db == "MFD", "MFD", "DB", missing = "DB")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mobs_Name), grepl("^MOB", mobs_Name)) %>%
  group_by(source, mobs_Name) %>%
  summarise(
    plasmid_count = n_distinct(representative),
    ptu_count = n_distinct(ptu, na.rm = TRUE),
    dptu_count = n_distinct(dptu, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(mobs_Name, source = c("DB", "MFD"),
           fill = list(plasmid_count = 0, ptu_count = 0, dptu_count = 0)) %>%
  left_join(source_totals, by = "source") %>%
  mutate(
    plasmid_pct = plasmid_count / plasmids_total,
    ptu_pct = ptu_count / ptus_total,
    dptu_pct = dptu_count / dptus_total
  )

# combine RP and MOB summaries
rp_mob = bind_rows(
  rp_df %>% rename(reduced_gene_name = rps) %>% mutate(group = "RP"),
  mob_df %>% rename(reduced_gene_name = mobs_Name) %>% mutate(group = "MOB")
) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("RP", "MOB")),
    source = factor(source, levels = c("DB", "MFD"))
  )

# order each panel by DB plasmid counts; log10 gives the same ordering
gene_order = rp_mob %>%
  filter(source == "DB") %>%
  arrange(group, desc(plasmid_count)) %>%
  pull(reduced_gene_name)

rp_mob = rp_mob %>%
  mutate(reduced_gene_name = factor(reduced_gene_name, levels = unique(gene_order)))

# one row per gene, source and plasmid/PTU/dPTU
plot_df = rp_mob %>%
  select(group, source, reduced_gene_name, ends_with("_count"), ends_with("_pct")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ends_with("_count"), ends_with("_pct")),
    names_to = c("unit", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(count|pct)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(unit = factor(unit, levels = c("plasmid", "ptu", "dptu"),
                       labels = c("Plasmid", "PTU", "dPTU")))

# shared layout for counts and percentages
rp_mob_plot = ggplot(plot_df, aes(reduced_gene_name, fill = source)) +
  facet_grid(unit ~ group, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("DB" = "gray", "MFD" = "blue"), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = trimws) +
  labs(x = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  figure_theme +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 270, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.location = "panel",
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

# zero counts have no bar on a logarithmic axis
counts = rp_mob_plot +
  geom_col(aes(y = if_else(count > 0, as.numeric(count), NA_real_)),
           position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75,
           colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(10, 1000, 10000), labels = comma) +
  expand_limits(y = 100000) +
  labs(y = "Groups with RP/MOB (log₁₀)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

percents = rp_mob_plot +
  geom_col(aes(y = pct * 100), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
           width = 0.75, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_y_sqrt(breaks = c(5, 25, 50)) +
  labs(y = "Groups with RP/MOB [%]") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# panel label at the upper-left corner
counts = counts + labs(tag = "C") +
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 0.97))

# counts above percentages; the upper plot supplies the panel-aligned legend
gene_count_plot = (counts / percents) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.3, 1))

gene_count_plot
```


# figure d
```{r}
traits_all = fread(file.path(data_dir, "traits_all.tsv")) %>%
  rename(var = trait, group_axis = group)

# trait order from top to bottom within each category
trait_order = c(
  "RPs", "Replicon type", "MOBs family",
  "Defense subsystem", "MRGs", "ARGs",
  "Domain", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species",
  "MFD01", "QMFD01", "IMG/PR ecosystem"
)

# add plotting labels to the summary file
traits_all = traits_all %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      var %in% c("rps", "reps") ~ "RPs",
      var == "replicon_type" ~ "Replicon type",
      var == "mobs_Name" ~ "MOBs family",
      var == "defense_subtype" ~ "Defense subsystem",
      var == "mrg_gene" ~ "MRGs",
      var == "args" ~ "ARGs",
      df_name == "sylph_sample" ~ "MFD01",
      df_name %in% c("sylph_no_na", "sylph_comb_no_na") ~ "QMFD01",
      var == "ecosystem" ~ "IMG/PR ecosystem",
      TRUE ~ var
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(label %in% trait_order) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      label %in% c("RPs", "Replicon type", "MOBs family") ~ "Backbone",
      label %in% c("Defense subsystem", "MRGs", "ARGs") ~ "Accessory",
      label %in% c("MFD01", "QMFD01", "IMG/PR ecosystem") ~ "Environment",
      TRUE ~ "Taxonomy"
    ),
    label = factor(label, levels = rev(trait_order)),
    category = factor(category, levels = c("Backbone", "Accessory", "Environment", "Taxonomy")),
    group_axis = factor(group_axis, levels = c("dptu", "ptu"), labels = c("dPTU", "PTU"))
  )

trait_colours = c("dPTU" = "white", "PTU" = "black")
pd_c = position_dodge(width = 0.55)

# shared layout keeps the two columns aligned
trait_plot = ggplot(traits_all, aes(y = label, fill = group_axis, group = group_axis)) +
  facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c("Defense subsystem" = "Defense\nsubsystem",
                              "IMG/PR ecosystem" = "IMG/PR\necosystem")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = trait_colours) +
  labs(y = NULL, fill = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
  figure_theme +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80", linetype = "dotted"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 90, size = 10),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.location = "panel",
    legend.key.width = unit(2.5, "mm"),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

jaccard = trait_plot +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(x = weighted_jaccard,
        xmin = weighted_jaccard - sd_jaccard_weighted,
        xmax = weighted_jaccard + sd_jaccard_weighted),
    orientation = "y", position = pd_c, width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = weighted_jaccard), shape = 21, size = 2.5, position = pd_c) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.1, 1.25), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Jaccard") +
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5))

groups = trait_plot +
  geom_point(aes(x = n_groups), shape = 21, size = 2.5, position = pd_c) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 5000, 10000, 15000),
                     labels = c(0, 5, 10, 15)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2000, 17000), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Groups\n(thousands)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text.y = element_blank(), strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

jaccard = jaccard + labs(tag = "D") +
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.tag.position = c(0.04, 0.98))

trait_plot_c = (jaccard | groups) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 0.85))
# align this legend with the bar-plot legend
trait_plot_c = trait_plot_c +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(4, 0, 0, 0, unit = "mm")))
trait_plot_c

# show both legends in each curve plot
curve_legend = theme(
  legend.position = "top",
  legend.justification = c(0, 1),
  legend.box.just = "top",
  legend.box.spacing = unit(1, "mm"),
  legend.box = "horizontal",
  legend.direction = "vertical",
  legend.title.position = "top",
  legend.spacing.y = unit(1, "mm"),
  legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
  legend.key.height = unit(3, "mm"),
  legend.key.width = unit(9, "mm"),
  legend.spacing.x = unit(1, "mm")
)
rarefaction = rarefaction +
  labs(colour = "Categories", linetype = "Groups") + curve_legend +
  guides(linetype = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(linewidth = 0.66)))
pc_rarefaction = pc_rarefaction +
  labs(colour = "Categories", linetype = "Groups") + curve_legend +
  guides(linetype = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(linewidth = 0.66)))

# put the outermost ticks at the same relative position
rarefaction = rarefaction +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 160000, 40000),
                     labels = comma,
                     limits = c(0, 176000), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 60000, 20000), labels = comma,
                     limits = c(0, 66000), expand = c(0, 0))
pc_rarefaction = pc_rarefaction +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 800000, 200000),
                     labels = comma,
                     limits = c(0, 880000), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 160000, 40000),
                     labels = comma,
                     limits = c(0, 176000), expand = c(0, 0))

# swap the axes so protein clusters are on the y-axis
pc_rarefaction = pc_rarefaction +
  labs(x = "Protein clusters\n(30% identity)") + coord_flip()

# panel label for the two rarefaction plots
rarefaction = rarefaction + labs(tag = "A") +
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 0.97))

pc_rarefaction = pc_rarefaction + labs(tag = "B") +
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 0.97))

# combine the panels using patchwork
figure_ab = rarefaction | pc_rarefaction
figure_bc = (free(gene_count_plot) | free(trait_plot_c)) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.6, 1))
figure_plot = (figure_ab / free(figure_bc)) + plot_layout(heights = c(0.65, 3))

# page size and margins
figure_width = 21
figure_height = 21.9
figure_margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "mm")
figure_plot = figure_plot +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.margin = figure_margin))

# save the combined figure
dir.create(figure_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "f2.png"), figure_plot,
       width = figure_width, height = figure_height,
       units = "cm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```
